name: Constructivism (web)
summary: Diagonal compositions, heavy sans-serif type, photomontage and flat red, black and cream blocks. It came from the Soviet avant-garde and treats the page as a poster that makes a call to action.

philosophy.core_thesis: The page is a machine for persuasion: every element is a lever, and the diagonal gives it energy.
design_principles: Set the main axis of a hero at an angle of 15° to 30°; rotate type blocks and image blocks together.
Use three colours only: red (#D62718), black (#111111) and cream (#EDE3CC); red covers 25% to 40% of the surface.
Build headings from heavy condensed or extended sans-serif capitals at 64px or larger, in 1 to 3 lines.
Cut photographs into hard shapes (circle, triangle, strip) and place them in monochrome black and red.
Use thick bars of 12px to 24px and circles as structure; each bar points at the next action.
Make each page carry one call to action in a red block, at 3 times the size of the body text or larger.
Overlap at least two elements in each composition by 8px to 40px.
anti_patterns: Soft gradients, shadows and glass effects
Pastel palettes or more than 3 colours
Decorative illustration that makes no call to action

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid that is rotated for the hero by 15° to 30°; the rest of the page returns to the grid. Bars of 12px to 24px divide the sections.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Diagonal or flush-left; headings may run at an angle; body text stays horizontal and flush left.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles, circles and triangles with a 0px radius; thick bars and wedges as dividers.

font_pairings.note: A heavy grotesque in the spirit of Rodchenko's posters.
A condensed face for tall headlines.
A compact capital face with a clear text partner.

typography.tracking: Display takes -0.01em to +0.02em; body stays at 0.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: bold (700) for display, regular (400) for body.
Set all headlines in upper case.
Set one word of a headline in a red block with cream text.

color.palette_structure: Red, black and cream; red is the energy colour.
color.contrast_rules: Black on cream holds 15:1; cream on red holds at least 4.5:1 for 24px bold text and larger.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, matt, printed colour blocks with a halftone grain at 6% opacity.
color.light_and_shadow: None; depth comes from overlap and from the angle of the blocks.

materiality.surface_simulation: Cheap offset print on newsprint; surfaces are flat ink and do not imitate other materials.
materiality.border_rules: Solid black bars of 4px to 12px; no outline on all four sides of a container.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. No elevation. Shadow offset is 0px.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid geometric pictograms (arrow, star, megaphone, gear) with square terminals and no fine detail; place an icon on a red block.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Photomontage in black and red, cropped into circles and wedges; no gradients.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: hard, fast slides along the diagonal axis; no bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover swaps the red and black blocks; active state shifts the block by 4px along the diagonal.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels urgency, energy and a call to join.

avoid_when: The audience expects calm, trust and quiet.
The product is a dense data tool.
The brand is luxurious or gentle.

modifiers.how: Return to the strict grid; keep the red accent and drop the angle and the photomontage.
Add pastel fills and squiggle patterns; keep the geometry.
Add a 4px black border and a hard offset shadow to each block.

pack.why: A solid, sharp-cornered family with butt terminals that reads as a stamp on a red block.

ground.why: Constructivist posters cut the page with a red wedge and a black diagonal beam.

Christopher Phillips, Photography in the Modern Era (Met, 1989)
